{'text': "The Labour Department today (the 10th) announced that Wah So Ice Room (Prince Edward) provided false information to the department during the local open recruitment period when applying for imported labour, and was subjected to administrative sanctions by the department, including immediate termination of the company's application and refusal to process the company's applications for the following year. Related report: Imported Labour｜What were the 18 cases subject to administrative sanctions sanctioned for? 1,365 complaints received in three years, about 10% warned or subject to administrative sanctions", 'index': 0}

{'text': 'Wah So Ice Room (Prince Edward) was subject to administrative sanctions by the Labour Department for providing false information during the local open recruitment period.', 'index': 1}

{'text': 'A spokesperson for the Labour Department pointed out that after investigation, it was confirmed that Wah So Ice Room (Prince Edward) provided false information during the local open recruitment period for applying to import waiters, junior chefs and dishwashers, violating the regulations of the "Enhanced Supplementary Labour Scheme", and was therefore subject to administrative sanctions. The department has immediately terminated the company\'s submitted application for importing foreign labour, and refused to process the company\'s applications submitted under the Enhanced Scheme for the following year.', 'index': 2}

{'text': "The department emphasised that employers importing foreign labour must strictly comply with the regulations of the scheme, including priority hiring of suitable local workers. If employers violate labour or immigration laws, the Enhanced Scheme or standard employment contract regulations, the Labour Department will impose administrative sanctions, including termination of the employer's submitted applications, revocation of the employer's approved imported labour permits, and refusal to process the employer's subsequently submitted applications.", 'index': 3}

{'text': 'Together with Wah So Ice Room (Prince Edward), whose sanctions were just announced today,集誌社 has compiled 18 cases of companies being penalised for violating imported labour regulations, of which 10 companies belong to the catering services and cleaning industries. What were they penalised for? Of the 18 companies, 9 involved unreasonably refusing to hire local job seekers, and most were refused by the Labour Department to process their imported labour applications for the following two years; another two restaurants, after importing foreign labour, dismissed local employees and had their approved foreign labour permits revoked immediately.', 'index': 4}
